title: Performing Six
body:
<center>Six is all you need, and will ever need.</center>
<center>Sodium, Lithium, Reese's Sodium Options, Ferrite Core, Bad Optimizations, Entity Culling</center>

***

**You do not need 30 mods in a modpack to get the best possible performance you can get from your device.**

Six keeps it to the essentials, and allows you to make it suit yourself with peace of mind. No more compatiblity issues when adding your mods. No more frame drops. No more memory leaks.

Six will work with all of your vanilla worlds. Out of the box. Even if they are from different instances, versions or mod loaders.

Recommendations

```
Windows 7 or later
Modrinth Launcher
Fabric Loader Version 16.10+
Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better ( A gpu made in the last 15 years should work. )
ARM or x86_64 CPU Architecture
2GB+ DDR3 Memory
Intel Core i3-3210, AMD A8-7600, Apple M1 or better
```
